primary_outcome: Human accepts the edited explanation or identifies concrete changes; acceptance remains pending until reviewed.
technical_checks: Actual participant cwd, model, effort, and six-skill catalog match the run
Raw inputs and installed skill packages retain recorded hashes
A full video decodes and is 1080x1920 with intended audio and timing
Final audio loudness and true peak are measured, with any deviation explained
Source/output timeline, captions, graphics sources, and render instructions are retained
Caption cues are ordered, in range, and free of unintended timing overlaps
Default portrait composition keeps graphics above and camera below, with both panels substantial and the full canvas used
Safe-zone evidence distinguishes reference-mask checks from actual organic app previews
Caption and key-content checks use reservations scoped to the actual placement; ad references alone do not define organic pass/fail
human_checks: The portrait layout keeps a prominent speaker below the motion graphics and uses the frame well
One focused takeaway is understandable without the long video and retains necessary qualifications
Cuts preserve words, natural pacing, and audio/video synchronization
The processed voice sounds natural and noise is less distracting
Motion graphics clarify the idea and remain legible at phone size
Captions are accurate and do not obstruct important content
judgment_rules: Use pass, fail, or unverified with cited evidence. Do not convert measurements into human naturalness scores. No controlled skill-improvement claim without comparable runs.
platform_preview: Actual organic Shorts, Reels, and TikTok previews remain unverified until checked in their apps.
